self_hash_policy: Manifest does not hash itself to avoid a self-reference cycle. Parent backup commit may bind this manifest.
scope: Only files actually reviewed directly or by independent literature subreviewer are listed. No claim that external dependency targets listed inside author freeze were opened.
snapshot_policy: Bindings identify reviewed versions. Later author status/decision changes require separate provenance and do not retroactively alter this snapshot.
